messages:
Maya: Ok team — proposing a webinar focused on practical tradeoffs: 'Cost & Latency Tradeoffs for Production Inference'. Wed Jun 18, 10:00am PT. Goal: top-of-funnel leads for Dedicated + Redwood Optimize. Quick sync: topic, speakers, run-of-show, rehearsal slots?

Alex: love it. target audience = platform + ML infra (SMB -> mid-market). I'd lead product + a short roadmap piece.

Sam: I can do a live demo showing batching + fallback to cheaper quantized model. Need ~15m and a dry-run on staging infra.

Priya: Customer case study: Acme Health is open to a 8–10m segment if legal signs off. I'll confirm by EOD.

Jordan: For lead routing: please add a form field "deployment interest" with values: Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Route Dedicated interest to the sales queue (segment: enterprise). Also want UTMs in promo links.

Maya: good call. I'll ask Ops to add the form fields. Draft registration copy idea: "How to balance latency, cost, and reliability when shipping LLM features" — short and practical.

Sam: demo requirements: GPU pod with warm KV cache, a small synthetic load generator, and a fallback model variant available. Can we reserve a dedicated pod for rehearsal?

CalendarBot: Event created: Webinar "Cost & Latency Tradeoffs for Production Inference" — Wed Jun 18 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT. Guest access: link will be generated after registration.

Maya: run-of-show draft (please comment inline):
```
10:00 - 10:05 Maya — Welcome + objectives + housekeeping (5m)
10:05 - 10:15 Alex — Product framing: where customers struggle + outcomes (10m)
10:15 - 10:30 Sam — Live demo: batching, cache, fallback, metrics dashboard (15m)
10:30 - 10:38 Priya + Acme rep — Customer story: why they moved to Dedicated + results (8m)
10:38 - 10:50 Panel Q&A — Alex, Sam, Priya (12m)
10:50 - 10:55 Maya — CTA, next steps, surveys (5m)
```

Priya: that timing looks good. Can we shift demo to 20m if Acme wants more time? Otherwise okay.

Alex: prefer to keep demo lean. If Acme needs more time we can shorten Q&A.

Maya: rehearsal plan: 1) tech check with Sam + CalendarBot 30m before live; 2) full dress rehearsal (slides + demo + transitions) two days before — everyone on panel must attend. Proposed slots: Jun 16 09:00 PT or Jun 17 11:00 PT. Thoughts?

Sam: Jun 17 11:00 PT works for me. I'll bring a checklist: pod reserved, demo data, metrics dashboard URL, fallback artifacts.

Jordan: marketing promo timeline: 2 weeks out — blog + email to warm leads; 1 week out — paid ads + social; 2 days out — reminder. Need speaker headshots + 1-sentence bios by Friday.

Maya: noted. I'll produce the registration landing copy + email templates. Priya, please share customer quote and slide by Tuesday if Acme approves.

Alex: slide deck owner = Alex. I will include a 1-slide TL;DR and leave space for live metrics screenshots.

Priya: Acme legal asked for a short MSA addendum, I'll coordinate with Security and update by EOD.

Maya: AV checklist (quick): mic check, screen share permissions, presenter spotlight setup, backup presenter, recording enabled, live captions. Any additions?

Sam: add fallback recording path in case Zoom instance fails — switch to broadcast-only link and push CTA in chat.

Jordan: capture lead source param in the reg form (utm_source). Also add a hidden field for account_owner in the payload so AE routing works.

Maya: action items recap: Alex = deck + TL;DR slide; Sam = reserve pod & rehearsal checklist; Priya = customer sign-off + slide; Jordan = reg form fields & routing; Maya = landing + emails + schedule rehearsals. Rehearsal = Jun 17 11:00 PT.

Sam: :thumbsup: I'll post pre-rehearsal checklist and share staging links in #eng-runtime by EOD Jun 15.

Priya: :raised_hands: Confirming Acme availability for Jun 18. Will update thread.

Maya: thanks team — I'll book the slots and create the rehearsal calendar invite now.

CalendarBot: Rehearsal event created: Wed Jun 17 18:00 UTC / 11:00 PT — "Webinar Dress Rehearsal: Cost & Latency". Attendees: Maya, Alex, Sam, Priya, Jordan.

Jordan: I'll draft the promo copy and drop it here for reviews.

Maya: perfect. Quick note: track registrant counts daily and share a pre-webinar snapshot 24h before.

Alex: anything else? otherwise I'll start the deck and ping for reviews.

Maya: nothing else for now. thanks everyone — will follow up with the invite + next steps. :sparkles:
